title: Graph-XGB: A Hybrid GNN Framework for Outdoor-to-Indoor 5G Signal Reconstruction via Aerial-Only UAV RF Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2611.26828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Delivering robust In-Building Coverage (IBC) is critically impeded by severe Outdoor-to-Indoor (O2I) attenuation, a constraint that intensifies as deployments move from 5G mid-band towards mmWave and prospective 6G sub-THz carriers, where losses of 60-80 dB have been reported across modern building envelopes. While Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer scalable exterior RF sensing platforms, a fundamental inversion problem persists: interior 3D signal states cannot be directly sampled from constrained exterior flight paths. This paper proposes Graph-XGB, a hybrid inference framework that decouples spatial topology reasoning from non-linear signal regression to resolve this challenge. A modified SpiderGNN encoder, operating on a topology-aware graph constructed with a physically grounded Floor-Aware 3D Distance metric and Bridge Edge Guarantees, propagates UAV boundary measurements into 128-dimensional indoor embeddings. translated_title: Graph-XGB：一种基于纯空中无人机射频感知的室外到室内5G信号重构混合图神经网络框架
translated_abstract: 提供稳健的楼内覆盖被严重的室外到室内（O2I）衰减所严重阻碍，随着部署从5G中频段向毫米波及未来6G亚太太赫兹频段演进，这一制约进一步加剧——据报道，现代建筑围护结构造成的损耗可达60-80 dB。虽然无人机提供了可扩展的外部射频感知平台，但一个根本性的反演问题依然存在：室内三维信号状态无法从受限的外部飞行路径中直接采样获得。本文提出Graph-XGB，一种将空间拓扑推理与非线性信号回归相解耦的混合推理框架，以解决这一挑战。经过改进的SpiderGNN编码器，在基于物理意义的楼层感知三维距离度量和桥接边保证所构建的拓扑感知图上运行，将无人机边界测量传播为128维室内嵌入。主成分……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Graph-XGB混合推理框架，通过改进的SpiderGNN编码器（结合楼层感知三维距离与桥接边保证）将无人机边界射频测量传播为室内嵌入，并与非线性回归解耦，实现仅凭空中感知的室外到室内5G信号三维重构。
en_tdlr: Graph-XGB decouples spatial topology reasoning (via a modified SpiderGNN with Floor-Aware 3D Distance and Bridge Edge Guarantees) from non-linear signal regression to reconstruct indoor 3D 5G signals using aerial-only UAV RF measurements.
